data_card.measured: Rainfall from 14 sources, 70 hydraulic sensors (35 ultrasonic level sensors, flow meters and conductivity-based CSO detectors) in the Fehraltorf combined sewer, 2019–2021.
data_card.method: Eawag Urban Water Observatory: wireless sensor network with quality-controlled annual databases.
data_card.uncertainty: Sensor accuracy and quality flags are documented in the dataset; to be recorded when the reference is built.
known_issues: The SWMM base model does not include the network changes of August 2020.
swisstopo geodata keep their own attribution terms.
data_card.exercises: Combined-sewer routing, surcharge and CSO operation under real storms, at a sensor density far above usual practice.
data_card.cannot_tell: As for Bellinge: run unchanged, the published model mostly measures the model. The 2020 network change means post-August-2020 storms test a model that no longer matches the network.

events.notes: Not in the published dataset; to be requested from Eawag for a blind round.

validation_design.holdout_policy: Calibrate on 2019, score on January–July 2020. A blind round needs records after 2021, which are not published; those would be requested from Eawag and released only when the round closes.

title: Fehraltorf Urban Water Observatory (Switzerland)
